annotation:
A simple, professional digital slide or sign on a solid teal-green background promoting an academic unit. The composition is minimal and left-aligned: two stacked lines of large, light-lime-green sans‑serif text reading “Innovation Academy” sit in the upper-left quadrant, with a much smaller, white sans‑serif subline beneath reading “Faculty of Engineering, HKU.”

Key visual details:
- Background: a smooth, dark teal to blue‑green field with no pictorial imagery or patterns; the right side of the frame contains plenty of empty negative space, giving the layout an open, modern feel.
- Primary text: “Innovation Academy” in a clear, contemporary sans‑serif typeface; the word “Innovation” appears in a lighter weight while “Academy” is slightly bolder (both in a lime‑green / chartreuse color that contrasts strongly with the darker background).
- Secondary text: “Faculty of Engineering, HKU” set in small white type, left-justified under the primary headline and functioning as an institutional attribution.
- Alignment and spacing: all text is left-aligned and positioned toward the top-left area of the image, leaving the remainder of the slide uncluttered.
- No people, animals, or other objects are visible; the image reads as a title slide, banner, or a signage panel for an academic program or event.

Overall impression: a clean, modern institutional graphic likely used for presentations, signage, or a web header to identify the Innovation Academy within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Hong Kong (HKU). The color and typographic choices emphasize clarity and a contemporary academic/innovation identity.

A full-color promotional poster advertising a student pitching competition for engineering postgraduates. Overall design and layout
- Dominant deep navy-blue background with orange and white accent panels and yellow highlights; a simple hand-drawn yellow lightbulb icon sits near the main title to suggest ideas/innovation.
- Large horizontal orange banner across the upper center contains the main title in large white type: "Pitching Contest". Directly beneath that, on a white rectangular strip, is the subtitle in dark-blue type: "for Engineering MSc students".
- Top-right corner contains a rectangular logo block (dark bluish-green background) reading "Innovation Academy Faculty of Engineering, HKU" in light green/yellow text.

Left-side imagery
- Two circular photographic cutouts stacked vertically along the left margin.
  - Top circle shows a single presenter (adult, holding a microphone and a small clicker/remote) in front of a presentation screen. The subject’s face is blurred in this supplied image; clothing appears dark blazer over white top.
  - Bottom circle shows two presenters (a man and a woman, both holding microphones and standing close together). Faces are blurred. The man wears a two-tone knit sweater; the woman wears a pale blazer.
- Circular photos are outlined with thin pale-blue rings and slightly overlap the poster’s content area.

Main text/content area (center-right)
- Organized as several titled sections with yellow section headings and white or light-blue supporting text. Sections are arranged in a multi-column style centered on the poster:
  - Themes (heading in yellow) with bullet points:
    - Smart technology for better living
    - Innovations under post-pandemic world
    - Human–computer interface and integration
    - Other technology-related matters
  - Categories (yellow heading) with bullet points:
    - Design concept / research idea
    - Hands-on projects
    - Technology-related service learning
    - Product realisation / applications
  - Review of proposals and pitching (yellow heading) with two bullets:
    - All proposals will receive feedbacks for improvement.
    - Shortlisted proposals will be invited to pitch their ideas on November 18, 2021.
  - Winners (yellow heading) with two bullets describing awards:
    - Winning proposals are eligible to apply funding for further developing the ideas, and will be awarded a cash prize of HK$1,200.
    - "The Best Presenter" will be awarded a cash prize of HK$1,000.

Important logistical details (highlighted toward the bottom)
- A line in yellow text reads: "Briefing: 2:30pm on September 16, 2021 in Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing."
- A bold announcement in larger type combines yellow and white: "Submission Deadline: 23:59pm on October 15, 2021."

Footer area
- Narrow yellow bar across the bottom contains three square QR codes labeled (from left to right) "Details", "Briefing", and "Join now" (small vertical labels in the yellow strip).
- Next to the QR codes, a short line invites viewers to visit a website for details and shows a URL (rendered as a tiny link to the Innovation Academy site).
- Social-media icons and handles appear on the right side of the footer area (Facebook and Instagram icons and the Innovation Academy handle text).
- Very small supporting text at the very bottom references funding/support by Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund (hard to read at full resolution but present).

Visual / typographic notes and composition
- Clean, corporate/academic look with clear visual hierarchy: title > themes/categories > logistics.
- Colors: navy blue background, orange title banner, yellow headings and accents, white and light-blue body text.
- Photographic elements on the left provide human context (students/presenters), while the right side carries the informative text.
- No individual persons are identified by name on the poster; the pictured faces in the supplied image are blurred and function as illustrative event photography.

Context and intended audience
- Clearly targeted at MSc engineering students at HKU (Innovation Academy / Faculty of Engineering).
- Purpose: solicit proposal submissions for an innovation/idea pitching contest, outline themes, categories, deadlines, prize information, and briefing details; provide quick-access QR codes and a website for more information.

A promotional poster-style image advertising a pitching competition titled “PITCH your innovative ideas.”

What is shown / overall layout
- The composition is horizontally oriented with a clean light-gray textured background. The visual focus is split between a bold typographic title across the upper third and a tactile central graphic (pins and string) slightly to the right of center. Supporting informational text is arranged down the left side and across the lower third, with a QR code and organizational branding on the right.

Title and typography
- Top-left: five red square blocks with white capital letters spell P I T C H in a slab-serif/block typeface; each letter sits inside a rounded-corner red tile.
- Overlapping those tiles and extending across the center is a large, flowing cursive script in vivid royal/ultra blue reading “your innovative ideas.” The cursive is energetic and slightly transparent where it overlaps other elements.

Central graphic / key objects
- A stylized physical network made from silver push-pins (nails) and braided twine forms an outer hexagonal ring of pins. Inside that ring three inner pins are connected by bright yellow/orange twine forming a smaller triangle; this inner connection is illuminated with a warm yellow/orange glow suggesting a highlighted idea or “bright” concept.
- The push-pins cast realistic soft shadows on the pale surface, lending a three-dimensional, tabletop look to the scene. Additional scattered pins appear to the right, outside the hexagon, giving a sense of workspace or construction.

Informational text (left column)
- Several blocks of explanatory text in small neutral gray type are aligned down the left:
  - “All Engineering undergraduates, taught postgraduates and InnoHub members are welcome to join!”
  - “All proposals will receive suggestions on areas of improvement to strengthen the ideas. Shortlisted proposals will be invited to join the pitching event in March 2023.”
  - “Winning proposals will have an opportunity to obtain a maximum of HK$100K funding support to further develop the ideas.” — the phrase “a maximum of HK$100K” is emphasized in bold red.

Deadline and callouts (lower left)
- A rounded white rectangular badge with subtle shadow contains the proposal submission deadline in large maroon text: “11:59pm, Jan 31, 2023.” Above it in smaller gray is the label “Proposal submission deadline:”.

QR code and details (lower center-right)
- A black-and-white QR code appears near the lower center-right with the small caption “More details” above it. The QR sits on the pale background and is prominent but not dominant.

Branding and footer
- Top-right contains a dark slate/charcoal rectangular badge with lime-green text: “Innovation Academy” and a smaller line beneath reading “Faculty of Engineering, HKU.”
- Bottom-left corner shows a short URL: “https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk” and a small magnifying/search icon; adjacent tiny gray text reads: “The activity is supported by Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund.” This footer text is unobtrusive.

Colors and visual tone
- Dominant palette: pale/light gray background, bold red (title tiles and funding highlight), royal/ultra blue (cursive headline), warm yellow/orange glow in the central graphic, neutral silvers for pins, and dark gray/charcoal for the Innovation Academy logo block.
- The overall tone is modern, creative and professional — combining tactile, hands-on imagery (pins & string) with bold typographic calls-to-action to evoke ideation, connection and support for student innovation.

Audience and context
- The poster targets engineering students and InnoHub members (explicitly stated) and promotes proposal submission for a pitching event with potential funding support and mentoring. The inclusion of the Innovation Academy / Faculty of Engineering, HKU logo situates the event within a university engineering context (HKU).

Other visible details
- The poster feels like a physical-workspace metaphor: the pins and twine imply linking, prototyping and networking; the glowing inner triangle emphasizes one idea being highlighted or chosen.
- Shadows and soft lighting contribute to a realistic tabletop appearance. The design balances bold headline graphics (left/top) with a central conceptual visual and practical submission details (lower-left and QR for more information).

A small horizontal social-media style label/badge on a deep navy-blue rectangular background.
- Key elements: a rounded Facebook "f" icon on the left and two lines of white text to the right.
- Facebook icon: a small filled circular blue button (slightly lighter than the background) containing the lowercase white “f” trademark, positioned flush to the left edge with modest padding around it.
- Text: two stacked lines in white, left-aligned with the icon.
  - First line reads: "Innovation Academy," (with a visible comma).
  - Second line reads: "Faculty of Engineering, HKU".
  - Typeface appears to be a clean sans-serif with the top line slightly more prominent than the bottom (clear hierarchy but both are white and high-contrast against the dark background).
- Colors and contrast: the composition uses a deep navy background, a slightly lighter blue for the Facebook circular icon, and bright white for the “f” and the text, giving strong visual contrast and easy legibility.
- Layout and spacing: compact, horizontally oriented badge — icon at left, text block to the right; ample negative space around elements so they read clearly at small sizes.
- Visible text exactly as shown: "Innovation Academy, Faculty of Engineering, HKU".
- People/animals: none present.
- Context/purpose: looks like a social-media page identifier or footer badge used to link or reference a Facebook presence for the Innovation Academy within the Faculty of Engineering at HKU (University of Hong Kong). The design is minimal and suitable for use on web pages or social profiles.

A wide horizontal promotional poster for an idea‑pitching competition called “InnoSpark.” The overall aesthetic is dark/black with bright neon colors and energetic light‑ray accents radiating from left toward the right, giving a dynamic, tech‑creative feel.

Key visual elements
- Large stylized light bulb graphic occupying the left third of the image. The bulb is composed of layered colorful words and ribbon shapes (words include THINK, IDEA, creative, design, planning, art, concept, inspiring, business, innovation) arranged to form the bulb’s rounded top; the screw base is rendered as stacked neon bands (blue, orange, green). Radiating neon streaks and spark lines surround the bulb.
- Prominent title “InnoSpark” in large bold orange lettering at the top right, with a white subtitle beneath: “An idea pitching event for building your community of interest and passion.”
- A column of rounded, colored information boxes (pale yellow, pink, light green, light blue, pale green) stacked down the right/center area carrying the event’s main details: eligibility and submission deadline, themes, categories, shortlisted event date, and winners/prize information.
- Small organisational branding at lower left: a dark green rectangular badge reading “Innovation Academy Faculty of Engineering, HKU” with the label “Organised by:” above it.
- Bottom center area contains two visible QR codes, a short URL (https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk), and social media icons/handles for Facebook and Instagram (labels indicate Innovation Academy, Faculty of Engineering, HKU and innoacademy_hku).
- Bottom right area repeats small organizational logos/text for Innovation Academy / Faculty of Engineering, HKU.

Colors and style
- Background: deep black with multi‑colored light streaks and starburst lines providing motion and energy.
- Light bulb and text use a vibrant neon palette: cyan, magenta, lime green, yellow, orange, violet and red. Information boxes use soft pastel fills (yellow, pink, mint green, pale blue) with black or dark text for readability.
- Typeface: bold, modern sans‑serif for the title and clear readable fonts in the info boxes; decorative hand‑lettered style inside the bulb words.

Text and informational content (visible highlights)
- Title: “InnoSpark”
- Tagline: “An idea pitching event for building your community of interest and passion.”
- Eligibility/submission: “All Engineering undergraduates and InnoHub members are welcome to submit proposals by February 1, 2021.”
- Themes: “Smart technology for better living; Innovations under post‑pandemic world; Human‑computer interface and integration; and any other technology‑related themes.”
- Categories: “Design concept / Research idea; Hands‑on projects; Technology‑related service learning; and Products realization / applications.”
- Shortlist notice: “Shortlisted proposals will be invited to the pitching event on February 23, 2021.”
- Winners/prizes: winning proposals eligible for further support and “a cash prize of HK$1,200”; “The Best Presenter” awarded “a cash prize of HK$1,000.”
- Call to action and links: QR codes and URL (https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk) and social media handles/labels for Innovation Academy.

People/animals/location
- No people or animals are pictured; the poster is entirely graphic and text. Contextual cues (Innovation Academy, Faculty of Engineering, HKU) identify the organising institution as the University of Hong Kong’s engineering innovation unit, implying a university/academic setting for the event.

Composition and purpose
- Composition balances a strong visual left (word‑built light bulb) against an information‑dense right side (title and colored text blocks). The energetic neon artwork draws attention, while the stacked pastel boxes organize practical details for students and members.
- Purpose is clearly promotional and informational: to invite engineering undergraduates and InnoHub members to submit proposals, outline themes/categories/dates, and advertise prizes and follow‑up support.

Overall impression
- A vibrant, youth‑oriented academic event poster combining creative, idea‑centric imagery with clear logistical information for a university innovation pitching competition.

Overall description:
- A colorful promotional poster advertising an undergraduate pitching event run by the Innovation Academy (Faculty of Engineering, HKU). The design is energetic and informal, combining bold hand-brushed type, geometric background texture, photo cutouts and several information boxes laid out across the page.

Top area and header:
- Background across the top is a warm yellow-orange with a subtle hexagonal/grid texture.
- Large hand-painted white script headline centered near the top reads: "Pitch your idea" with a red handwritten-style subtagline underneath: "and grow your own community of interest!"
- Above the headline, smaller black text reads: "All Engineering Undergraduates and InnoHub members are welcome!"
- Top-right corner contains a dark green rectangular logo block reading: "Innovation Academy Faculty of Engineering, HKU."

Left graphic:
- A large stylized lightbulb illustration occupies the upper-left quadrant. The bulb is white with yellow highlights and a large yellow question-mark motif inside, with a dark green base — reinforcing the ideas/innovation theme.

Main content area — information boxes and photos:
- The center section is organized into several rectangular blue/purple boxes containing short lists and instructions, arranged against a white lower background with a faint grid.
- Left-middle: a dark indigo-blue box titled "Themes" (white text). Listed items (bulleted) include:
  - Smart technology for better living
  - Innovations under post-pandemic world
  - Human-computer interface and interaction
  - Other technology-related matters
- To the right of Themes, another purple-blue box titled "Categories" lists:
  - Design concept / research idea
  - Hands-on project
  - Technology-related service learning
  - Product realisation / applications

Review/pitching and winners:
- A light purple/blue box toward the lower center-left is titled "Review of proposals and pitching" and states:
  - Shortlisted proposals will be invited to the pitching event on March 2, 2022.
  - All proposals will receive feedbacks for improvement.
- Adjacent to that, a darker blue box titled "Winners" explains prizes and follow-up support, including opportunities to apply to the "Funding Scheme for student projects / activities by Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Innovation Fund" for further development, a cash prize of HK$1,200, and that "The 'Best Presenter' will be awarded a cash prize of HK$1,000."

Photos and visual accents:
- Several circular photo cutouts are placed around the information boxes:
  - Upper-left circular photo shows a person (face blurred/masked) holding a microphone and presenting. The presenter appears to be indoors at an event stage or seminar.
  - A smaller horizontal circular photo below shows an audience/lecture setting with a presenter and a projected slide on a screen.
  - Upper-right features a large circular group photo of many people wearing masks, holding signs/trophies — an apparent group event/award photo.
  - Middle-right is a circular portrait-style photo of an individual holding a microphone (face blurred/masked).
- All people in the photos appear to be wearing face masks, suggesting COVID-era safety precautions. No individuals are identified by name.

Submission details and QR codes:
- A wide yellow banner across the lower center prominently displays the submission deadline in bold red text: "Submission deadline: 23:59pm, January 28, 2022."
- Bottom-left corner contains a small orange-labeled box "More info" above a QR code.
- Bottom-right corner contains another orange-labeled box "Submission" above a second QR code.
- Footer text (small) provides a web address for more details: "For more details, please visit https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk." A supporting statement at the bottom notes the activity is supported by Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund.

Color, layout and tone:
- Color palette: warm yellow/orange header, white lower background with light grid, and multiple blue/purple information panels for contrast; accent red used in the subtitle and deadline to draw attention.
- Layout: clear hierarchical structure — eye drawn first to the big script headline and lightbulb, then to the themes/categories boxes, review/winner boxes, and finally to the submission deadline and QR codes.
- Overall impression: an academic/innovation event flyer that is visually engaging, informative, and aimed at undergraduate engineering students inviting idea submissions and participation in a pitch event.

Overview:
A polished promotional poster advertising a technology pitch competition organized by the Innovation Academy, Faculty of Engineering, HKU. The design uses a dark blue, high-tech themed background with glowing node-and-connection (network/constellation) graphics and bright accent colors to create a futuristic, innovation-focused feel.

Layout and composition:
- Top area: a left-aligned rectangular green logo block reading “Innovation Academy / Faculty of Engineering, HKU” sits near the top-left corner. Dominating the top center is the large headline in all caps: “PITCH NEW TECH IDEAS” in bold white/very light-blue lettering with a soft glow. Directly beneath the headline is a smaller tagline in lime-green: “Pioneering Solutions for Tomorrow’s Challenges.”
- Middle area: three equally sized visual panels (rounded-corner squares) arranged horizontally across the center of the poster, each with a short caption beneath:
  - Left panel (Human-AI Collaboration): a close-up photographic illustration of a human index finger reaching toward a robotic, metallic hand — reminiscent of a “touching” gesture between human and robot. Background is soft teal/blue and out-of-focus, emphasizing the two hands. Caption below reads “Human-AI Collaboration.”
  - Center panel (Water Sustainability): a stylized, semi-abstract image of a large translucent water droplet or holographic orb hovering above a natural shoreline at sunset/sunrise, with concentric glowing rings and digital/tech overlays. Colors here include deep blues, cyan glows, warm orange from the horizon and reflective water. Caption below reads “Water Sustainability.”
  - Right panel (Design for an Aging Population): an indoor scene depicting an older adult seated in an armchair holding or gesturing toward a tablet; a small white robot/robotic pet sits beside them on the chair arm. The person’s face appears intentionally softened/obscured. The living-room setting uses warm beige and soft brown tones; small framed photos and a potted plant appear in the background. Caption below reads “Design for an Aging Population.”
- Body copy (center-lower): a paragraph of information in white text explaining the prize: “Chance to win a maximum of HK$100K funding support to further develop your ideas in Innovation Wing.” The phrase “maximum of HK$100K” is emphasized in red. A follow-up sentence in smaller white text: “All proposals will receive suggestions on areas of improvement to strengthen the ideas. Shortlisted proposals will be invited to join the pitching event in March 2026.”
- Call-to-action block: a bold white rectangular box centered near the bottom containing large black text: “Proposal Submission” and below it smaller text: “by 11:59pm, March 1, 2026.”
- Bottom-right corner: a QR code with small yellow text above it reading “MORE DETAILS.” A short website URL is shown in a small white rounded label near the lower-left edge: “https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk” (or a similarly formatted innoacademy.engg.hku.hk address).
- Footer line (very small): a credit/support notice reading: “The activity is supported by Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund.”

Colors and visual style:
- Dominant color palette: deep navy / midnight blue background with lighter blue node-and-line network patterns and glowing white/teal accents.
- Accent colors: bright white for headings and key copy, lime-green for the tagline, red to emphasize the funding amount, yellow for the “MORE DETAILS” label, warm oranges in the water-sustainability image and warm beige tones in the aging-population illustration.
- Typography: bold, all-caps headline; clean sans-serif fonts for headings and body copy; use of weight and color to create hierarchy (title > panel captions > body info > submission deadline).

Text visible (key excerpts transcribed):
- “Innovation Academy / Faculty of Engineering, HKU” (logo)
- “PITCH NEW TECH IDEAS”
- “Pioneering Solutions for Tomorrow’s Challenges”
- Panel captions: “Human-AI Collaboration” / “Water Sustainability” / “Design for an Aging Population”
- Main incentive line: “Chance to win a maximum of HK$100K funding support to further develop your ideas in Innovation Wing.”
- Supplemental line: “All proposals will receive suggestions on areas of improvement to strengthen the ideas. Shortlisted proposals will be invited to join the pitching event in March 2026.”
- Call-to-action: “Proposal Submission by 11:59pm, March 1, 2026”
- QR code area labeled “MORE DETAILS”
- Footer: “The activity is supported by Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund.”
- Small URL: “https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk” (displayed near the bottom-left).

People, objects and key imagery:
- Human-robot interaction motif (left panel) — human finger and metallic robotic hand about to touch.
- Holographic water droplet/tech sustainability motif (center panel) — combines nature (shoreline, sky) with digital/tech overlays.
- Aging-population scenario (right panel) — older adult in armchair using a tablet, accompanied by a small robotic companion; home interior elements such as framed pictures and a plant.
- Functional elements: QR code for more details, submission deadline box, organizational logo.

Location/context:
- The poster is clearly targeted to students, researchers or innovators associated with the Innovation Academy (Faculty of Engineering) at the University of Hong Kong (HKU). It promotes a pitch competition with funding support and a March 1, 2026 submission deadline; shortlisted proposals will present in March 2026.

Overall impression:
A modern, visually striking event poster that blends human-centered imagery (interaction, aging care) with environmental and technological themes (water sustainability, AI collaboration). The hierarchy and color emphasis guide the viewer from the title and themes, to the funding incentive, and finally to the clear submission deadline and QR code for more details.

A cropped horizontal UI header bar styled to match Instagram’s branding: on the far left sits the familiar Instagram app glyph and to its right is a long rounded rectangular input/search field occupying most of the frame.

What is shown
- A compact top-of-app/header strip: left-aligned Instagram icon followed by a wide pill-shaped white input area.
- No people, animals, or photographic scene — this is a user interface graphic element.

Key objects and layout
- Instagram icon: a small square with rounded corners rendered in the app’s multicolor gradient; the internal white camera/glyph silhouette is visible, centered inside the square. The icon is flush against the left margin of the header.
- Search/input field: a horizontally elongated rounded rectangle with a pure white fill and very soft corner radius. It begins immediately to the right of the logo and extends nearly to the right edge of the crop.
- Inside the white input area are faint, short horizontal strokes suggesting placeholder text or a search hint (these appear as light grey bars rather than readable characters).
- Thin horizontal colored bands form the background above and below the header area — a slim darker purple stripe along the very top and a slightly thicker magenta/pink stripe along the bottom edge of the image, framing the UI element.

Colors and visual styling
- Dominant Instagram gradient colors: vivid purple and magenta/pink tones visible in the logo and bordering bands. The gradient on the icon suggests orange/pink/purple blending characteristic of Instagram branding.
- Clean white input field providing strong contrast against the colorful logo and surrounding stripes.
- Placeholder strokes are light grey, low-contrast, and purposefully non-legible to indicate sample text rather than real content.
- Overall styling is flat/minimal with soft rounded corners and no heavy shadows — typical of modern mobile/web app header design.

Text and legibility
- No readable text strings; only abstract placeholder marks inside the input field. No logos or words beyond the icon glyph itself.

Location/context inference
- This appears to be a UI header or navigation/search bar from an Instagram mobile or web interface (or a stylized mockup of one). The composition and branding cues (camera glyph, gradient) strongly indicate Instagram, but the crop is limited to the top bar only — not an entire screen.

Overall composition and impression
- Minimal, centered-on-function composition: icon at left anchors the header, long input field dominates the visual flow to the right. The colorful brand accents (purple/magenta stripes and gradient icon) frame and draw attention to the otherwise clean white control. The image reads as a tidy, modern app header designed for quick recognition and immediate input/search interaction.

A brightly designed event poster advertising a student pitching competition titled "PITCH NEW TECH IDEAS." The composition is split visually from left (dark) to right (bright): the left side uses a deep charcoal/black background for headline and informational text, while the right side is a high-key pale grey/white area dominated by a large clear incandescent light bulb held at its base by a human hand. The light bulb (glass, visible filament) and the hand are centered on the right and act as the visual metaphor for ideas and innovation.

Headline and tagline
- Top-left corner: the word "PITCH" appears in a stylized red, three-dimensional serif display font. Directly beneath and much larger, the main title "NEW TECH IDEAS" uses the same bold red 3D lettering with drop shadows and strong beveling, making it the poster's dominant element.
- Under the headline, a script/rounded sans line in bright neon purple reads the tagline: "Bettering our Society and Quality of Life through Innovation" with a soft outer glow effect.

Informational blocks and icons (left-center)
- Three white rounded rectangular speech-bubble style text boxes are stacked vertically on the left side, each preceded by a colorful icon:
  - A pink and blue jigsaw puzzle-piece icon accompanies the top box that says: "All HKU undergraduates are welcome to join!"
  - A yellow circular icon bearing a stylized lightbulb/idea symbol is next to the middle box that explains proposals will receive suggestions and shortlisted proposals will be invited to a pitching event in March 2024.
  - A green stack-of-cash icon prefixes the bottom box that announces: "Winning proposals will have an opportunity to obtain a maximum of HK$100K funding support to further develop the ideas in Innovation Wing." The amount "a maximum of HK$100K" is highlighted in red within that white box.

Deadline and call-to-action (bottom-left / center)
- A bold blue three-dimensional headline near the bottom-left reads: "PROPOSAL SUBMISSION by 11:59pm, Jan 31, 2024." The blue text is large, attention-grabbing, and set against the darker background for strong contrast.

Right-lower corner: QR code, button and URL
- Bottom-right contains a white rounded rectangle with a black QR code labeled "More details" above it.
- Immediately under or beside the QR code area a small URL is visible: https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk (printed in small type).
- A small circular magnifier/search icon appears near the URL.

Branding and sponsor note
- Top-right corner: a small rectangular logo for "Innovation Academy Faculty of Engineering, HKU" in green text on a dark slate background.
- Very small fine-print centered at the bottom of the poster states that the activity is supported by "Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund" (support/sponsorship line).

Visual style, colors and composition
- Overall color palette: bold reds for the headline, neon purple for the tagline, bright blue for the deadline, white and black for copy panels, and accent icons in pink, yellow and green. The left side’s dark background creates high contrast with white text boxes; the right side’s bright area around the light bulb draws the eye and reinforces the theme of invention.
- Typography mixes heavy, decorative display type for the main title with clean sans-serif body copy in the white boxes.
- The large photographic lightbulb and the human hand are the only photographed elements; no faces or other people are shown. There are faint geometric and gradient effects in the background to add depth.

Visible text highlights (verbatim or near-verbatim as shown on the poster)
- "PITCH NEW TECH IDEAS"
- "Bettering our Society and Quality of Life through Innovation"
- "All HKU undergraduates are welcome to join!"
- "All proposals will receive suggestions on areas of improvement to strengthen the ideas. Shortlisted proposals will be invited to join the pitching event in March 2024."
- "Winning proposals will have an opportunity to obtain a maximum of HK$100K funding support to further develop the ideas in Innovation Wing."
- "PROPOSAL SUBMISSION by 11:59pm, Jan 31, 2024"
- "More details" (above QR code)
- URL: https://innoacademy.engg.hku.hk
- Sponsor/support line: mentions Tam Wing Fan Innovation Fund and Philomathia Foundation Innovation Fund.

Overall impression
- A promotional poster aimed at HKU undergraduates, visually combining bold headline typography and icon-supported informational callouts with a large symbolic image (light bulb in hand) to emphasize idea generation, innovation funding, and a firm submission deadline. The layout guides the viewer from the dramatic title on the left, down through the participation/funding details, and toward the QR code/URL call-to-action on the right.

A promotional poster for a student pitching competition titled “PITCH NEW TECH IDEAS,” laid out as a dramatic stage/lecture-scene background with overlaid blocks of text and information.

What is shown and overall composition
- The upper half of the image is a shallow-focus photograph of an auditorium or conference hall: the backs of many seated audience heads in the foreground (blurred, viewed from behind) and a single, out-of-focus person standing at a lectern on a lit stage in the mid-background. Bright stage lights create bokeh highlights and a sense of depth; blue light beams and warm spotlight tones are visible.
- Superimposed over this scene is the primary headline and a tagline in large, highly legible type. The lower half of the poster is a darker graphic band with informational text blocks, a white submission box, a highlighted session/workshop panel, a QR code, and a small URL and sponsor line at the footer.
